ZAF.note: The speech cites only 'national frameworks' for personal information and names no law.

facts.fact: The Chief Electoral Officer says the voters' roll was certified on 12 March 2024 at 27.7 million voters, registration runs through an online portal used by 2.4 million since July 2021, and electronic copies went to contestants.

ZAF.note: The speech urges the media to report responsibly and states no criticism, cut or punishment.
